**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the gap — e.g. "there's no collector for X" or "I want alerts to go to Y".

**Proposed approach**
If you have one in mind: which module would this touch
(`baselineguard/collectors/`, `baselineguard/alerts/`, ...)? Does it fit the
project's zero-mandatory-dependency stdlib-only design (see
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`), or does it need an optional dependency?

**Alternatives considered**
Any other way you thought about solving this.
